new_rules_proposed.name: Target Repo Validator
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if target repo publication status is claimed without clone/fetch evidence and target mapping
new_rules_proposed.prevents: W18 pattern: final-state-dashboard claimed only external gates remain when DWG/target-repo work was still local
new_rules_proposed.implementation_note: Validate coordinator/target-repo-map.json exists and target-publication/gate-detection.json shows gate status

new_rules_proposed.name: DWG Fixture Validator
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if DWG packages remain FIXTURE_BLOCKED without official Aspose.CAD repo search evidence
new_rules_proposed.prevents: Leaving DWG blocked without attempting acquisition from official samples repo
new_rules_proposed.implementation_note: Check dwg-acquisition/source-repo-scan.json exists before accepting FIXTURE_BLOCKED status

new_rules_proposed.name: PR Created Evidence Validator
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if PR_CREATED is claimed without live PR URL evidence
new_rules_proposed.prevents: Dry-run commands being classified as actual PRs
new_rules_proposed.implementation_note: target-publication/live-pr-results.json must contain pr_url fields with github.com/... format

new_rules_proposed.name: Self-Contained PR Packet Validator
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if PR packet index references prior-sprint packets not physically present or explicitly validated
new_rules_proposed.prevents: W18 pattern: pr-packet-index.json claimed 33 but only 13 were in bundle
new_rules_proposed.implementation_note: Count physical pr-packet.json files in W19 evidence tree + validate external references

new_rules_proposed.name: Taskcard Finality (enhanced)
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if any sprint taskcard is PENDING at closeout (not pre-bundle closure tasks)
new_rules_proposed.implementation_note: Distinguish: pre-bundle-closure PENDING tasks are OK; all other PENDING = FAIL

new_rules_proposed.name: Final-State-Dashboard Gate Accuracy
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if final-state-dashboard claims only_external_gates_remain=true when locally solvable items exist
new_rules_proposed.prevents: W18 pattern: dashboard said only external gates remain but DWG fixture was locally acquirable

new_rules_proposed.name: Package Proof Completeness
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if package proof lacks restore.log + build.log + run.log + output-validation.json
new_rules_proposed.prevents: Partial proofs being promoted to CANONICAL_PACKAGE_PROVEN
new_rules_proposed.implementation_note: Check wave19-dryrun/examples/*/*/ for all 4 required files

new_rules_proposed.name: Registry Consistency Check
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if registry_status=CANONICAL_PACKAGE_PROVEN without canonical_package_path pointing to existing directory
new_rules_proposed.implementation_note: Verify canonical_package_path exists in filesystem for each PROVEN entry

new_rules_proposed.name: External Evidence Authority (enhanced)
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if sprint_status=SPRINT_COMPLETE and external sidecar .sha256 does not match frozen bundle
new_rules_proposed.prevents: W17/W18 pattern: sidecar missing from uploaded artifact
new_rules_proposed.implementation_note: Verify sidecar SHA matches recomputed bundle SHA

new_rules_proposed.name: Backlog Exhaustion Validator
new_rules_proposed.rule: FAIL if TRANSFORMED_TO_EXAMPLE_DRYRUN items exist without attempted promotion decision
new_rules_proposed.prevents: Items silently remaining at intermediate status indefinitely
new_rules_proposed.implementation_note: Each TRANSFORMED_TO_EXAMPLE_DRYRUN item must have explicit decision: promote or defer with reason
